newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara says yen's rise too rapid - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara says yen's rise too rapid - Jiji.

text.p: Foreign exchange movements have been too rapid and excesssive volatility in the foreign exchange markets is undesirable, Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, was quoted as saying by Jiji news agency.
Jiji said his comments were in response to questions on the dollar's fall below 112 yen in late Tokyo trade.
This was a drop of more than three yen from its New York close on Monday. Bankers said the dollar had fallen due to expectations of a narrowing interest rate gap between the United States and Japan.
